laws.rule: Harz National Park (mostly Saxony-Anhalt, with a western part in Lower Saxony, including the Brocken): walk on signed paths only (about 600 km of signed walking trails). Dogs must always be on a lead. No open fire, including grills and camp cookers, and no smoking; the park cites fines of up to EUR 25,000 (about A$39,700 at RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293) under the state forest laws. No fireworks anywhere in the park, all year, including on the Brocken summit. Camping and bivouac are prohibited. Boats and stand-up paddleboards on the waters are prohibited, and so is walking on ice in winter. Bikes are allowed on most walking trails; horse riding only on marked riding trails.

Gesetz uber die Sonn- und Feiertage (FeiertG LSA) sections 4, 5 and 10
laws.rule: Saxony-Anhalt bans noise and events that disturb church services on Sundays and public holidays (during the morning main service), and on Maundy Thursday, Buss- und Bettag and Christmas Eve (section 4). Extra protection applies from 5 am on Good Friday, from 5 am to 4 pm on Volkstrauertag, from 5 am on Totensonntag and from 4 pm on Christmas Eve: events in rooms that serve drinks and go beyond food and drink service, public sport events and other public events are banned unless they honour the day or serve art, science or education and respect its character (section 5). A breach can be fined up to EUR 1,500 (about A$2,384) (section 10). AUD at A$1 = EUR 0.6293 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026).

laws.heading: Nichtraucherschutzgesetz (Gesetz zur Wahrung des Nichtraucherschutzes) section 2, section 3 and section 8
laws.rule: Smoking is banned in public-service buildings, hospitals, schools (and their grounds), childcare and youth facilities, universities, sports halls, culture venues, hotels, bars and restaurants, shopping centres and discos (sections 2 and 3). Sections 4 and 6 allow exceptions such as marked smoking rooms. The Act speaks of smoking and does not name e-cigarettes. A breach, and a venue's failure to put up signs or act, can be fined; the Act sets no amount (section 8). AUD at A$1 = EUR 0.6293 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026).
laws.penalty_signal: Fine; amount not set in the Act.

laws.heading: Waldgesetz Sachsen-Anhalt section 22, section 28, section 29 and section 38
laws.rule: In Saxony-Anhalt, camping in a tent, putting up caravans or motorhomes and making fireplaces in open country, including forest, need the user's prior agreement (section 22(2)). Fire danger rules (section 29): throwing away burning or smouldering things in open country is banned; at fire-danger levels 2 to 5 smoking outdoors in the forest or within 15 m of it is banned; lighting an open fire in the forest, or within 30 m of it at levels 2 to 5, is banned except at public barbecue sites; at level 5 leaving the paths in the forest is banned. Dogs must not run loose unsupervised in open country, and must be on a lead from 1 March to 15 July (section 28(2)). Fines under section 38: the open-fire and leaving-the-path offences (section 37(2)) up to EUR 25,000 (about A$39,725); the offences in section 37(1) up to EUR 50,000 (about A$79,450). AUD at A$1 = EUR 0.6293 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026).
laws.penalty_signal: Up to EUR 25,000 for fire offences; up to EUR 50,000 for section 37(1) offences.
